$Comment: A conditional damage bonus in whole percent points (10 is +10%) on its holder's charged attacks (an attack whose damage names the Charged class: a held swing, a crossbow's heavy combo bolt; never a way to tell a bow's full draw, since the game classes every shortbow arrow Charged, its file under ConditionalStats says why).
